0.$description: Immediate state changes; no decorative interpolation.

100.$description: Brief non-spatial feedback or reduced-motion fades.

200.$description: Short entrances and movement within the interface.

250.$description: Intermediate transitions when moderate travel warrants more time than a small control.

300.$description: Dismissal of large-area surfaces, allowing the eye to follow their departure.

350.$description: Large-area entrances and relocations; longer settling time avoids an abrupt spatial change.

500.$description: Reserved for large sheets with a steep settling curve. Requires a deliberate decision, not ordinary controls.

ease.$description: CSS ease: small changes in color, background or opacity.

out-expo.$description: Strong ease-out: responsive entrances and exits with a gentle settle.

in-out-cubic.$description: Acceleration and deceleration for movement already on screen.

linear.$description: Constant progress only, such as a time indicator; not ordinary UI entrances.
